name: Sliding Bars
description: Bars of the second clip slide in over the first one after another. Drive `progress` from 0 to 1.

inputs.name: second
inputs.description: Incoming clip (same size as the first)

params.name: vertical
params.description: Vertical bars sliding down/up instead of horizontal bars sliding right/left

params.name: direction
params.description: 0 = bars come in from the left (top when vertical), 1 = from the right (bottom)

params.name: stagger
params.description: 1 = each bar starts when the previous one lands, 0 = all bars move together
